svg.title: Pi Review Gate — sidebar-driven session control, orchestration, review and automation
svg.desc: An illustrative sidebar manages local and networked native Pi sessions. These sessions are separate from delegated worktree workers. An orchestrator coordinates work, web research and independent read-only review of captured evidence. Read-only research subtasks report without review or landing; this is not an exemption for native browser sessions. Additional tools provide execution, browsing, shells, scheduling, optional pre-execution auditing, durable evidence and recovery.
svg.text: Sidebar-driven session control, orchestration, review, and automation

g.aria-label: Native session host and task flows
g.text: Illustrative native sessions; worktree tasks are separate
Routes to workers or in-place work
Evaluate changes, test results, and evidence
Work with sessions on remote hosts
The sidebar is one part of a larger system
